headlines.headline: Russell 2000 Closes at Record 3,068, Up 22.7% YTD — Now +9.5 pp Ahead of S&P 500 as September Hike Odds Collapse
headlines.driver: For IWM: Positive — rate-relief repricing is IWM's #1 driver; each 25 bps of Fed pricing = ~2% Russell earnings (BofA) vs ~0.2% for QQQ, so September hold odds 60% directly lifts IWM's floating-rate-heavy constituents. Record close validates IWM as high-beta rates play, not earnings.

headlines.headline: IWM Gathers $733M as QQQ Sheds $4.55B — Rotation From Megacap Growth to Small/Mid Caps Accelerates
headlines.driver: For IWM: Positive flow — $733M inflow vs QQQ $4.55B outflow is direct buying pressure for IWM's 2000 names; shows allocators de-grossing AI megacap into breadth, lifting IWM even though fundamentals lag price.

headlines.headline: Small Caps at Cusp of History: Monthly StochRSI 89.4 Flags 10–15% Correction Risk Despite 27 Record Closes
headlines.driver: For IWM: Negative risk — StochRSI 89.4 >85 historically precedes 10-15% pullback in 2-3m even in bull markets; IWM's 27 record closes + extended longs means crowded long, so this driver caps chasing IWM at ATH despite YTD +22.7%.

headlines.headline: July CPI 3.4% and Flat PPI Remove September Hike Threat — Most Rate-Sensitive Corner Gets Fuel
headlines.driver: For IWM: Positive — two cool prints (CPI 0.1% MoM, PPI flat) removed hike premium; July CPI shifted September hold odds to 64% and gave IWM its most rate-sensitive bid — IWM +8.6% in 2 weeks vs SPX +1.6% was the transmission.

headlines.headline: Passive Reconstitution Funneled $334B Into Russell 2000 — 2026 Rally Driven by Flows, Not Earnings
headlines.driver: For IWM: Positive but mechanical — $334B June reconstitution forced passive buying = ~4x Russell turnover, explains IWM +21.8% YTD without earnings growth. Good for IWM price near-term, but means rally is vulnerable when flows fade after quad witch.

headlines.headline: Citi: Russell 2000 Longs Extended, Short Exposure Trimmed — New Money Slowing as Crowding Builds
headlines.driver: For IWM: Negative positioning — longs extended, shorts covered, weekly flows moderating = crowded long. IWM's upside now needs fresh catalysts (CPI, payrolls), not just short squeeze, so chasing here is paying for good news.

headlines.headline: IWM +5.42% in Two Days — Historical Analog Implies +14% in 6M, +36% in 12M on Such Thrusts
headlines.driver: For IWM: Positive thrust — 5.4% 2-day jump historically averages +14% in 6m/+36% in 12m as breadth capitulation signal; for IWM it validates momentum chase at 27th record, but sample includes recessions so not a guarantee.
